title: Comparison of Uterine Distension in Hysterosonography Among Patients Monitored for Infertility
official: Comparison of Uterine Distension in Hysterosonography Among Patients Monitored for Infertility
summary: Comparison of differences in distension by volumetric analysis of the uterus before and after distension between groups of infertile and apparently fertile women.
conditions: Infertile Women Undergoing IVF or ICSI
Distension by Volumetric Analysis of the Uterus
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient age ≥ 18 and \< 43 years old
* No contraindications to pregnancy
* Patients consulting at the Saint Denis assisted reproductive technology (ART) department due to desire to become pregnant or infertility

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindication to assisted reproductive technology treatment
